chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding a man who shaves his head in Makkah, he said: He should return the hair to Mina.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a pilgrim shaves his head in Makkah instead of Mina?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the geographical specificity of the Hajj ritual of tahalluq, emphasizing that while shaving may occur in Makkah, the act is ritually completed by transporting the hair to Mina. This ruling underscores the scholarly emphasis on adhering to the Prophet's prescribed locations for Hajj rites, ensuring the validity of the pilgrim's transition from the state of ihram. It reflects the practical jurisprudence of the Imams in addressing minor logistical variations during the pilgrimage.
